CFAN.stands_in_for: the fan cable and the clamp as one capacitance to the reference, both declared budgets

CPIN.stands_in_for: the receiver's filter at the high end of its tolerance plus the datasheet's pin capacitance

RAIL.stands_in_for: the logic rail at the low end of the regulator's stated accuracy, which is the worst case for reaching the receiver's high threshold

RPULLUP.stands_in_for: the sense pull-up at the high end of its tolerance, the value that charges the line slowest

RSAT.stands_in_for: the fan's open-collector output as the resistance that produces the declared output low level at the current this pull-up sources; the standard states neither, so both are the board's declarations

RSERIES.stands_in_for: the series element at the high end of its tolerance

TACH.stands_in_for: two pulses per turn at the highest rotation rate the board claims to resolve, as an ideal switch

description: one sense input pulsed at the rate the board's declared maximum rotation gives, through the pull-up, the cable and clamp capacitance, the series element and the receiver's own filter
name: sense_edge_at_the_top_declared_rotation_rate
